description: A small locally-defined advanced-intelligence suite. NOT a public benchmark and not comparable to one. Thirty items across five capabilities the Wave 0 and engineering-judgment suites do not exercise at all: recalling a unique code from a 400-record ledger placed in the prompt (long_context), choosing a well-formed tool call and the right response to a tool failure (tool_calling), ordering and revising dependent steps (agentic_planning), reasoning about physical, chemical and biological situations where the intuitive answer is wrong (scientific_reasoning), and answering arithmetic questions posed in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Indonesian and Portuguese (multilingual). WHAT THE LONG-CONTEXT ITEMS DO AND DO NOT MEASURE: the ledger is roughly 6,000 tokens, so a pass is evidence of recall across a prompt of that size and of nothing larger. It is NOT evidence of 32k or 128k ability and must never be recorded as such. The clearance codes are random strings, so they cannot be answered from prior knowledge, and each item lists the other five codes in must_not_contain so a model that recites all of them scores zero. A model whose context window is smaller than the prompt will error on these items and the run becomes DEGRADED, which is the correct outcome: it cannot do long context and the suite says so rather than scoring it on the rest. The 24 multiple-choice items are balanced six per letter across A-D, so always answering one letter scores 0.25 of them. Frozen by content hash before any model was run against it.
